notes.title: Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Yunhe Dreamcatcher Gift Box Now Available

· The Yunhe Dreamcatcher Gift Box will be available for a limited time after maintenance on September 11, 2025. Guests can purchase it in the Jade Shop.

· The gift box contains the Doodle Combat Background "Hide-and-Seek Planet," Card Back "Bamboo Shadows," "Doodle Alternative Art Selection Box," "Yunhe Dreamcatcher Title Selection Box," and "Secret Scroll Selection Box" ×5.

· Guests can use the "Yunhe Dreamcatcher Title Selection Box" to choose one of the following Titles to add to their collection: "Golden Brotherhood," "Dancing in Finery," or "Blossoming Together."

· Guests can use the "Doodle Alternative Art Selection Box" to choose any set of Doodle Alternative Art released before August 27, 2025 to add to their collection.

You can also choose the "Cloud River Dream Gathering Friendship Set," which allows you to gift a "Graffiti Alternative Art Selection Gift Box" and a "Cloud River Dream Gathering Title Selection Gift Box" to a friend. (Cannot be gifted again after sending)

Voyage Pass: S8 Now Available

· Available Time: From after the maintenance on September 11, 2025.

· Guests can spend 248 Jade to purchase the Voyage Pass: S8. Once purchased, Voyage Pass: S8 will be instantly leveled up to Lv.9, allowing guests to immediately earn all exclusive Doodle Alternative Art of the current Voyage Pass: Doodle Alternative Art for Hakuzosu: Tempered Heart's base Shikigami and its full set of 8 cards, along with the corresponding 9 Ink Splash Card Frames.

· The Voyage Pass has a total of 30 levels. Guests can earn points by completing the specified point quests to level up the Voyage Pass. Claim corresponding rewards once the Voyage Pass reaches a certain level. Each reward can only be claimed once.

· Guests can directly purchase levels for the Voyage Pass at a cost of 3 Jade per level. Please spend money responsibly.

The Flowers of Love Qixi Event Is Now Available!

Event Time: From after the maintenance on September 11, 2025 to 24:00 on September 24, 2025.

Event Description:

· During the event, guests can obtain Flowers by completing event quests.

· Guests can arrange flowers to create and gift bouquets favored by Shikigami. Upon success, you can earn Alternation Omnius Secret Scrolls, Ink Jade, Glass Stone, and Refined Stone as rewards.

· Players can repeatedly gift their preferred bouquets to Shikigami, and each gift will grant a Gold reward.

· After the event ends, the two Shikigami who received the most bouquets from players will send thank-you emails containing Alternation Omnius Secret Scroll rewards. (You must send at least 3 bouquets)

Doodle Alternative Art Limited-time Rerun

· Rerun Period: From after maintenance on September 11, 2025 to 23:59 on September 24, 2025.

· This rerun includes the following Doodle Alternative Art: "Shinkiro Doodle Alternative Art."

Alternative Art Takes Turns to Discount: Thirtieth Turn Begins

· Many Alternative Arts which have been sold for over one year will enjoy a discount for a limited time during each turn, guests can head to the Alternative Art Shop to purchase them! 

· Event Time: From 10:00 on September 11, 2025 to 9:00 on October 30, 2025. 

· This round's Alternative Art: "Ungaikyo: Mirror of the Alley," "Momo: Abundance," "Langyazi: Miracle Elixir," "Hiyoribou: Sunny Heartbeat Sake," "Sparrow: Cat on the Trip," "Kurumi: Fragrant Dye."

Other Improvements and Bug Fixes

· Fixed an issue where Deck Codes could not be shared if the deck contained too many types of cards, resulting in the code being too long.

· Fixed an issue where the card description of Koi's "Tail Whip" was incorrect. (Actual effect remains unchanged)

· Fixed an issue in Mirage Deep Records where some stage descriptions did not match the corresponding stages.

notes.title: Standard Ranked Match Balance Changes
notes.notes:
Standard Ranked Match Balance Changes

· The following cards have been nerfed:

Wishing Moon and Starry River

Before the Adjustment: Basic boost: +2 Power/+2 Shield

After the Adjustment: Basic boost: +2 Power

One Night's Dream

Before the Adjustment: Tactical: Revive one of your other Shikigami or grant one of your other Shikigami +1 Combat Power and initiate an Attack. When used from your Hand, additionally grant the Target Shikigami +1 Power and +1 Health.

After the Adjustment: Tactical Revive one of your other Shikigami or grant one of your other Shikigami +1 Power and initiate an Attack. When used from your hand, additionally grant the Target Shikigami +1 Power and +1 Shield.

The following cards have been enhanced:

Abyss of Purgatory

Before the Adjustment: Deal 3 Damage to an opponent's Shikigami. Focus: This card has Lifesteal.

After the Adjustment: Deal 3 Damage to an opponent's Shikigami. Focus: This card's Damage is increased by 1 and gains Lifesteal.

Master of the Original Plains

Before the Adjustment: Projectile: Deal 3 Damage. Focus: Attach "Nine-Tailed Power" to Tamamonomae of the Scorched Heavens.

After the Adjustment: Projectile: Deal 3 Damage. Focus: Choose one: Attach a "Nine-Tailed Power" to Tamamonomae; or randomly use one of Tamamonomae's Origin Spell Cards.

Evolve: Bakekujira

Before the Adjustment: Permanently attach Teeth Shell or Body Shell to Bakekujira. Evolve: Charge. Once per turn, when your Shikigami assault, Bakekujira gains 1 Energy and triggers the attached Teeth Shell and Body Shell one more time.

After the Adjustment: Permanently attach Teeth Shell or Body Shell to Bakekujira. Evolve: Charge. Once per turn, when your Shikigami assault, Bakekujira gains 2 Energy and triggers the attached Teeth Shell and Body Shell one more time.

Bless

Before the Adjustment: Randomly increases the level of one of the lowest level Shikigami of both players by +1.

After the Adjustment: Increase the level of your lowest level Shikigami and a random lowest level opponent's Shikigami by +1, then draw a card.

Hidden Leaf Swordsman

Before the Adjustment: Base Stats: 3 Power/3 Health

After the Adjustment: Basic stats: 4 Power/4 Health

Wings of Prayer

Before the Adjustment: Fast Randomly add a Kaoru Form Card to your hand. Owl's Guard loses Unique (does not stack). In this game, when Owl's Guard is attached to your Shikigami, attach it to all your Shikigami.

After the Adjustment: Fast Choose a Kaoru Form Card to add to your hand. Owl's Guard loses Unique (does not stack). In this game, when Owl's Guard is attached to your Shikigami, attach it to all your Shikigami instead.

Punishing Hands

Before the Adjustment: Enhance: Gain Fast during the turn this card is drawn.

After the Adjustment: Draw a card, then place a card from your hand on top of your Library. Enhance: Gain Fast during the turn this card is drawn.

Thunderclouds

Before the Adjustment: Basic boost: +0 Power/+1 Shield

After the Adjustment: Basic boost: +0 Power/+2 Shield

Mt. Ibuki

Before the Adjustment: Intensity: 4

After the Adjustment: Intensity: 6

Heat Wave

Before the Adjustment: Hunt Enhance: This card gains +2 Power and +2 Shield for every Delicacy card you gain during this game.

After the Adjustment: Hunt Enhance: For each "Delicacy" you obtain during this game, this card gains +2 Power and +2 Shield. Trick: Hunt.

Destined One

Before the Adjustment: At the start of your turn, add a Wind Blade to your Hand.

After the Adjustment: When entering the battlefield and at the start of your turn, add a Wind Blade to your Hand.

Turbulent Blade

Before the Adjustment: Basic boost: +0 Power/+0 Shield

After the Adjustment: Basic boost: +1 Power/+0 Shield

Other Improvements and Bug Fixes

· Fixed an issue where an opponent's Shikigami attached with the Invocation "Freeze" from Fengyang Jun would reattach "Freeze" upon taking Damage from Fengyang Jun's "Clear Snow Stream" Invocation.

· Fixed an issue where Oni Gold Sheep's "Master of Oni Stars" ability would still grant Direct Hit after an opponent's Shikigami with Power greater than or equal to 5 entered the Combat Zone and then left the Combat Zone.

· Fixed an issue where "Evolve: Ryomen" would not correctly grant Power boosts when consecutively using "Thunder Fury."

· Fixed an issue where Ungaikyo's "Hidden Sun" would only trigger the Projectile effect once when consecutively using "Hidden Sun."

· Fixed an issue where the displayed dice points of Yamausagi/Zashiki's "Lucky Dice" card did not match its actual effect when using the Shiny variant.

· Fixed an issue where Shinkiro's "Hundred Knowledge · Blue Leaf" would not count towards the usage count of "Moonlit Night" when there was no target available.

· Fixed an issue in "Companion Training" where, after mentoring a junior or guiding a senior, the training interface would display an unremovable notification (red dot) if there were unopened message alerts (red dots) prior to successfully completing the mentorship.

· Fixed an issue where "Evolve · Poverty God" could cause other opponent Shikigami to attach "Misfortune" even if it was defeated without having "Misfortune" attached.

· Fixed an issue where Kaguya's "Five Puzzles" would fail to randomly select a card if the turn timed out during card selection.

· Fixed an issue where Sakura's Reinforce card "Falling Petals" would not trigger its effect if an allied Shikigami was revived during the turn it entered the field.

· Fixed an issue where, under the scenario where your Sakura Yukihime's Field "Crimson Sakura" is active, your Yuki Onna's "Heart of Winter" has been used, and the first card played during your turn is Yuki Onna's "Graupel," the first "Snowball" generated by "Graupel" would not receive the Damage boost from "Heart of Winter."

· Fixed an issue where the interface could not be closed properly when using the Zen Heart Ungaikyo to chain a card with the "Empower" effect granted by Hiyoribou · Sunny Blessing, and the turn timed out while in the Empower selection interface.

· Fixed an issue where using the chibi-style alternative art deck in Friend Duel would incorrectly display a blank square on the card face in the preparation interface.

· Fixed an issue where the "Open All Packs" feature would only count one Secret Scroll towards Achievement statistics when opening multiple Secret Scrolls simultaneously.

notes.title: Update announcements
notes.notes:
【"Star Fate Strategies" Reinforce Card Grand Launch】

· Six new Reinforce cards will be added to the "Starry Strategy" Secret Scrolls after maintenance on June 19, 2025. 

· After the Reinforce cards of the "Stellar Strategy" data pack become available on June 19, players can log into the game to claim 3 free Stellar Strategy Card Packs. 

· "Starbound Strategies Reinforce Card Welcome Pack" will be available in the Jade Shop after maintenance on June 19, 2025, containing 15 Starbound Strategies Card Packs.

· The "Starry Strategy Reinforce Card Exclusive Gift Box" will be available in the Jade Shop after maintenance on June 19, 2025. The gift box contains 35 Starry Strategy Secret Scrolls and a random Starry Strategy SSR card gift box.

· The "Stellar Strategy Reinforce Card Premium Gift Box" will be available at the Jade Shop after maintenance on June 19, 2025. The gift box includes 50 Stellar Strategy Card Packs and a random Stellar Strategy SSR Card Gift Box.

【Reinforce Card Acquisition Event - Dreaming of Flowers Begins】

· Event Time: From 10:00 on June 19, 2025, to 24:00 on July 16, 2025.

· Event Description:

  During the event, players can claim 10 "Reinforce Points" daily from the event interface.

  Players can earn an additional 10 "Reinforce Points" for each match victory, with a daily limit of 40 points (applicable to Ranked Match/Player Match/Card Match/Investigation Society/Shotengai Combat/Hyakubun Chess).

  Players can earn 20 "Reinforce Points" by making their first recharge of any amount each day.

  Accumulating "Reinforce Points" allows guests to obtain SSR Reinforce Cards, corresponding Shikigami SR cards, 14-day trial cards for the Shikigami, Starbound Strategies Card Packs, and other rewards on the event page.

· Event Notice

  Players can claim Reinforce Points on the event page after daily login. Each player can claim up to 10 points per day. The claimable Reinforce Points will refresh daily at 00:00. Please remember to claim your points in time.

  Guests can earn 10 Reinforce Points each time they win in Ranked Match/Player Match/Game/Investigation Club/Shotengai Combat/Hyakubun Chess daily. Each guest can complete this task up to 4 times per day, and the task will refresh daily at 0:00.

  Players will earn 20 Reinforce points for their first top-up of any amount each day, and the first top-up will reset at 00:00 daily.

· The reward claim page will close along with the event page at 24:00 on July 16, 2025. Unclaimed rewards will be sent via mail.

· Guests who did not obtain Reinforce cards during the event can still synthesize Reinforce cards later using Talismans.

【Mirage Chronicles Gameplay Unlocked】

· Permanent PVE Gameplay: Mirage Deep Records is now open! Guests can participate in the gameplay at Shotengai Sparrow.

· In the Mirage Deep Record, players will take on the role of different Players as collectors of ghost stories, challenging various levels to gather ghost story information and complete the "Mirage Deep Record."

· Guests, playing as the player, will use a fixed deck to take on challenges.

· During each challenge, players will engage in several consecutive battles against AI decks. After each battle, players will restore all Health and receive deck enhancements.

· Players will receive a certain number of Revive attempts during challenges, which can be used to retry the challenge upon failure.

· Guests will receive a certain number of refresh attempts during challenges. When randomly refreshing selectable content, they can consume refresh attempts to re-roll options.

Mechanic - Player Level

· Players, as the role of the Player, will gain EXP based on challenge progress, allowing them to level up.

· Upgraded players will unlock various abilities beneficial for subsequent challenges, including "Initial Stats Boost," "Initial Spirit Blessing," "Initial Treasure," "Initial Equipment," and "Card Upgrades."

Mechanism - Equipment

· "Equipment" is an item that can be equipped by Shikigami in the deck.

· "Equipment" has various effects that activate when the equipped Shikigami meets certain conditions.

· Players can obtain "Equipment" both inside and outside the challenges of the Mirage Deep Record.

Mechanic - Card Upgrade

· Players can upgrade all 32 cards of the 4 Shikigami in their deck, with each card having two upgrade levels. (Reinforce cards are not included.)

· Players can obtain "Card Upgrades" both inside and outside the challenges of the Mirage Deep Record.

Mechanism - Treasure

· Players can obtain "Treasure" cards with various powerful effects both inside and outside challenges to enhance their deck strength.

Mechanic - Spirit Blessing

· Now, upon obtaining "Spiritual Aid," abilities are directly granted without relying on layer count for acquisition or upgrades.

· Obtaining duplicate "Spiritual Aid" still allows for ability upgrades.

· In the Mirage Chronicles, players can enhance their deck in various ways during combat breaks.

Stages and Difficulty

· As exploration progresses, the difficulty of the levels encountered by players will gradually increase.

· Each level has five difficulty settings. Completing each difficulty will unlock ghost stories in the Mirage Deep Record.

· Higher difficulty levels will result in opponents having more cards, stronger abilities, and certain initial value bonuses. Please prepare your player for cultivation accordingly.

· Various content for the Mirage Deep Record gameplay will be continuously updated. Please look forward to future updates.

Standard Ranked Match Balance Adjustments

The following cards have been nerfed:

Gathering Storm

Before adjustment: In this turn, Ryomen gains 2 Power, 3 Shield, and Hunt. Enhance: Ryomen gains Haste when this card is linked to and used.

Adjusted: In this turn, Ryomen gains 2 Power, 1 Shield, and Hunt. Enhance: Ryomen gains Haste when this card is linked to and used.

The following cards have been enhanced:

Wind Charm: Flash

Before adjustment: This card will self-destruct at the end of the turn. Trigger: Automatically plays when Ichimokuren is attacked.

Adjusted: Fast This card will self-destruct at the end of the turn. Trigger: Play automatically when Ichimokuren is attacked.

Cards that have been adjusted can be disenchanted according to their crafting price before 10:00 on June 25, 2025. (Up to twice for each type)

【Croak Chorus Avatar Frame Bundle Available】

· Limited animated avatar frame "Frog Chorus" will be available in the Jade Shop after maintenance on June 19, 2025. A limited-time offer will also be available at the same time, ending at 24:00 on July 2. Guests can purchase it in the Jade Shop.

【Midsummer Night's Dream Card Back Bundle Available】

· The limited dynamic Card Back "A Midsummer Night's Dream" will be available after the maintenance on June 19, 2025. A limited-time offer will also be available at the same time. The limited-time discount will end at 24:00 on July 2. Players can go to the Jade Shop to purchase it.

Appearances Return

· The Special Basic Card Alternative Arts "Momo · Falling Blossoms - Peach Edition" and "Peacock King - Dance of Divine Prayer" return, and players can purchase them at the Jade Shop.

· The Special Basic Card Alternative Art "Chen · Starry Path at Dusk" returns, and players can purchase it at the Jade Shop.

· The Special Basic Card Alternative Art "Oitsuki·Water Moon·Eclipse Shadow Chase" returns. Guests can purchase it in the Jade Shop.

【Doodle Alternative Art Limited-time Return】

· Return Time: From after maintenance on June 19, 2025, to 23:59 on July 2, 2025.

· The returning Doodle Alternative Art includes: "Gomaru Doodle Alternative Art," "Kusa·Pupu Doodle Alternative Art," "Maestro Doodle Alternative Art," "Mouba Doodle Alternative Art," "Yamausagi Doodle Alternative Art," and "Kagewani Doodle Alternative Art"!

· For more details on the graffiti Alternative Art Card designs, players can refer to previous content~

Improvements and Bug Fixes

· When the synergy effect of battle cards can be triggered, the synergy keywords on the cards will be highlighted with a color change.

· Adjusted the pacing of playing Spell cards and Combat cards. Now, when both sides play card effects, subsequent effects and actions will no longer be blocked.

· Fixed an issue where the game would freeze if the opponent's Library had no cards and Alena's Invocation was attached.

· Fixed an issue where defeating an opponent's Shikigami with the ability \[Self-Destruct When Injured] using damage from your side would not trigger your side's \[Defeat Effect]. For example: Saki "Four-Color Violet" and Ibaraki Doji "Rage Outlet."

· Fixed an issue where Kusa·Urupu did not trigger the entry effect of Form Cards obtained through Zashiki \[Fortune's Favor].

· Fixed an issue where players might be unable to close the Battlefield Shop interface after purchasing all items in the shop.

· Fixed an issue where players purchasing cards consecutively in the battlefield shop and using Chiryu "Return to Void" before the cards were added to their hand would cause errors and affect subsequent settlements.

【Exclusive Player Match Event - Bounty Frenzy Begins】
· Event Time: From 10:00 on May 22, 2025, to 24:00 on May 28, 2025.
· During the event, all Decks gain enhanced bounty rewards in the "Sealed Deck" Player Match.
· At the start of the match, the player will receive 2 additional cards: one "Universal Bounty" and one "Exclusive Bounty." The "Universal Bounty" grants a bounty bonus to the player (choose 1 out of 4 fixed abilities), while the "Exclusive Bounty" enables one Shikigami in the deck to gain the ability to earn bounties during the game (the method of earning bounties varies by Shikigami, and the bonus effect of the "Exclusive Bounty" applies only to that Shikigami).
· During the event, the Shop gains an additional effect: At the start of the game, the SSR of the current deck's Shikigami will be added to the Shop and can be purchased using bounties.
· During the event, the Shop gains additional effects: At the start of the game, extra Shop cards are unlocked for purchase based on the player's current Deck. Each Shikigami unlocks 2 different Shop cards, and different Shikigami may unlock the same Shop cards (in such cases, the purchase quantity will not stack).
· During the event, each customer gets 2 chances for free entry.
· There are 16 bounty acquisition methods for Shikigami and 30 new Shop cards for players to explore.
· At the start and end of this event, guests' game process in Sealed Deck will be settled, and rewards will be issued according to the wins with Jikikaeru Ticket x15 as compensation. Guests who have not logged in to the game during the event period will not be affected.

· Event Description:

  Players can claim Reinforce Points on the event page after daily login, with a maximum of 10 points per day. The claimable Reinforce Points will refresh daily at 00:00. Please remember to claim your points in time.
  Players can earn 10 Reinforce points for each victory in Ranked Match/Player Match/Card Match/Investigation Society/Shotengai Combat/Hyakubun Chess daily. Each player can complete this task up to 4 times per day, and the task resets at midnight daily.

Standard Ranked Match Balance Adjustments

The following cards have been enhanced:

Maintenance Time
Add an option during Assault: Lazy Guwa
Moyu Frog: If there is no Guaduo Momentum in the Combat Zone, randomly summon a Guatai, then grant the summoned entity of Onikage the effect "Self-destruct upon taking damage," and restore 2 Health to Onikage.

Gua Cleansing
Before Adjustment: If there is no Guado Multitude in the Combat Zone, randomly Summon a Guatai, then have the Summoned entity of Onikage use its exclusive card, and Onikage takes 3 Damage.
After the adjustment: If there is no Gua Duo Power in the Combat Zone, randomly Summon a Gua Tai, then have the summoned entity of Onro use its exclusive card, causing Onro to take 2 damage.

Gamble	
Before Adjustment: Whenever you use a stack card from your hand, Luck 4: Use another stack card of the same quantity.
Adjusted: Whenever you use a stack card from your hand, Luck 4: Use another stack card of the same quantity. For every 3 Shop cards you use during this game, the required Luck points decrease by 1.

Delion's Promise

Before the Adjustment: Basic boost: +0 Power/+0 Health
After the adjustment: Basic boost: +0 Power/+1 Health

Evolve: Kusa
Before the adjustment: When entering the battlefield, trigger Kusa's entering effect of her current form. Evolve: When Kusa uses a different Form Card from her current form, trigger the entering effect of the current form and draw a card.
After the adjustment: When entering the battlefield, trigger Kusa's entering effect of her current form. Evolve: When Kusa uses a Form Card, trigger the entering effect of the current form and draw a card.

Izuna Pact	
Before the adjustment: Reduce Kanko's Countdown by 2.
After the Adjustment: Attach a Vengeful Fox Mark to Shikigami in the opponent's Combat Zone and reduce Kanko's countdown by 2.

Divine Flames of Wrath	
Before the Adjustment: Each of your "Serpent Demons" launches an attack and becomes immune to attack damage.
After the Adjustment: Each of your "Serpent Demons" launches an attack, gains 1 Power, and becomes immune to attack damage.

Wrath of Unwillingness	
Before the Adjustment: Basic boost: +1 Power/+0 Shield
After the adjustment: Basic boost: +2 Power/+0 Shield

Night of Fear	
Before Adjustment: When entering the battlefield and at the start of your turn, attach Fear to a random opponent Shikigami that is not attached with Fear, and gain 1 Wing of Fear. Wing of Fear is playable when defeated, and can be played on your other Shikigami.
After the adjustment: Upon entering and at the start of your turn, bind "Fear" to a random opponent's Shikigami that is not already bound with "Fear" and gain two "Fear Wings." "Fear Wings" can be used upon being defeated and can target other allied Shikigami. Once per turn, each use of "Fear Wings" on Ten Gyaku increases its effect by 1.

Ace Commander	
Before the Adjustment: During your turn, when your Shikigami uses a Blessing Card or Burst Card, Taki gains Haste, Exaltation, and Barrier. Blessing 3: Taki gains Haste and Exaltation.
Adjusted: When entering the battlefield and when your Shikigami uses a Blessing card or Burst card during your turn, Taki gains Haste, Inspiration, and Barrier. Blessing 3: Taki gains Haste and Inspiration.

Evolve: Chi Li	
Before the adjustment: Discard a card and draw a card. Evolve: Once every turn, when you discard a card, Chi Li charges a matching faction's Flowing Cloud.
After Adjustment: Discard a card and draw two cards. Evolve: Once every turn, when you discard a card, Chi Li charges a matching faction's Flowing Cloud.

Enmusubi of All Things

· Fixed an issue where some new players using beginner decks in the Ranked Match during the Voyage phase could not match opponents properly.
· Fixed an issue in the deck editing interface where the Shikigami name at the bottom of the card might display incorrectly after switching Shikigami.
· Fixed an issue in the Deck editing interface where the Deck Assistant could not be used to add Cards.
· Fixed an issue where cards not owned would not be grayed out when constructing a deck using a deck code.
· Fixed an issue where the description of the "Charge" ability keyword was incorrect.
· Fixed an issue in the Hyakubun Scrollery where the rule description text for the "Oblivion Twin Secret Scroll" had an incorrect scroll name.
· Fixed an issue where Shikigami with Veiled could not Trigger the effects of Oni Gold Sheep's "Shadowy Passage" and "Oni's Startling Surprise" to play cards.
· Fixed an issue where Peacock Mingwang's "Caged Melody" triggered the trick effect of "Evolve: Peacock Mingwang" during its attack, and after shuffling back into the library, triggered Hanare's basic ability for divination, causing Peacock Mingwang to fail to properly become immune to attack damage.
· Fixed an issue where, after Nightfall 10, Kubinashi's "Shadowing" removed by Mouba would not return to the Hand at the start of the Turn.
· Fixed an issue where, if "Evolve: Chocho" used "One Night Dream" on another allied Shikigami and was Defeated due to an inserted effect during resolution, the other allied Shikigami would incorrectly return to the Standby Zone after an Attack.
· Optimized the card name of the Summoned Card from Enmusubi's "Enmusubi of All Things." The name "Enmusubi: All Things" has been changed to "En: Omnius" to distinguish it from the original card name.
· Fixed an issue where "Evolve·Kainin" bound to Hakuzosu·Sharpened Heart "Fox Flame·Red" would take 1 damage when attacking a poisoned Shikigami.
· Fixed an issue where Shikigami bound to Hakuzosu·Sharpened Heart "Fox Flame·Blue" could encounter abnormal damage resolution after using a Form Card.
· Fixed an issue where your Shikigami, at the start of the turn, charged to use a card or Avatar to use a card, triggering the opponent's Oni Kinyou's response to use "Oni's Surprise," causing your upgrade phase to be skipped for the current turn.
· Fixed an issue where Shuten Doji/Ibaraki Doji's Reinforce Card "Frenzied Song and Heroic Spirit" would not trigger the effect of "Evolve: Mio."
· Fixed an issue where Amaterasu's "Divine Judgment Field" effect would not trigger when using the Form Card "Heavenly Radiance" of Ketsu.
· Fixed an issue where the end-of-turn effect would not activate if Oni Kinyou was defeated by damage inserted into the resolution after using "Oni Star Surprise" Trigger.
· Fixed an issue where defeating an opponent's Standby Zone Shikigami using Ibaraki Doji's Form "Rage Outlet" effect did not trigger the "Infernal Blaze" Blaze effect.
· Fixed an issue where Tsukuyomi's "Planet" might not grant the Opponent Player the "False Moon" after placing the Opponent's Hand into the Enlightenment Zone.
· Fixed an issue where the description of the Player Match effect "Player Match: Chi Seal" item was incorrect.
· Fixed an issue where, after converting a standard Deck with two identical Reinforce Cards into an unlimited Deck, additional identical Reinforce Cards could be added to the Deck.
· Fixed an issue where Shikigami with Substitute ability would remove the attached Karasu Tengu's Autumn Leaves "Divine Power" and "Weakness" Invocations when triggering the Substitute effect.
· Fixed an issue where the effect of Hakuzosu·Sharpened Mind Invocation "Foxflame·Azure" could not activate under certain circumstances.
For example: Effects from cards like Ootengu's "Lord of the Storm" and Maestro's "Evolve: Entry" causing damage.
· Fixed an issue in the Shou's Kisei: Endless Chapter where, after using the Thief God’s "Treasure" while holding a Shapeshifting Youkai in Hand, the Shapeshifting Youkai would incorrectly transform into a Thief God Shikigami Card.
· Fixed an issue where using Blazing Pupil prevented the count of Bukkuman's Invocation from increasing.
· Fixed an issue where, during Hououka's "Nirvana Purgatory Flames" effect, Empower Cards were not recognized as Level 1 Cards.
· Fixed an issue where Hakuzosu's Invocation "Foxflame: Azure" would still take effect after disappearing.
· Fixed an issue where, when using the Four Dots Alternative Art to attach a Zashiki to Yoto Hime: Cursed Blade, the Zashiki effect would revert to its original effect after Yoto Hime transformed using an Evolve Card.
· Optimized the issue where Ketsu's Gata's arrival caused damage to itself during the assault of the Oboro Car. Now, Gata's arrival no longer increases non-combat damage to allies.

[Ninth Release: Dragon Abyss Secret Realm Boarding Preparation]
· Event Time: 16 Jan, 2025, 10:00 to 23 Jan, 2025, 18:00.
· From 16 Jan, 10:00 to 22 Jan, 24:00, guests can vote to support their favorite Dragon Abyss Secret Realm boarding Shikigami on the event page.
· After the event ends on 23 Jan, guests will receive one SR card and seven R cards of the Shikigami they voted for as a reward.
· All guests participating in the vote will receive two "Dragon Abyss Secret Realm Secret Scrolls" as an extra reward after the event ends.

[Optimization and Bug Fixes]
· Fixed the issue where you could form a lineup with two Shikigami of the same faction using Menreiki: Heart Star.
· Fixed the issue where, after the Koto Player used Grand Ensemble to trigger the Kagura Song effect, the Awakening Mountain Wind would not trigger its awakening effect when other Shikigami reduced the countdown.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43425662/6149d50db9d9e5b62e8d19e5835770be0a78e3c5.png
The Shinki Championship Has Begun!
Be the most outstanding one once again! 
· Event Time: From after the maintenance on January 2, 2025 to 24:00 on January 11, 2025. 
Event Description:
· Guests can sign up for the Shinki Championship, pick their best deck, and compete with other guests for the championship.
· Guests can build decks that can only be used during the event with all cards from all seasons (excludes Kyonshi Imoto) for free and use these decks to play against others. The cards guests use will be their strongest version among multiple balancing adjustments (based on past win rates, adjustments have been made to certain cards.)
· The event is divided into three stages: qualifiers, semi-finals, and finals. 
Guests can register up to three times per day during the qualifier/semi-final stage. The first registration is free and subsequent registrations will each cost 10,000 Gold. Guests can register twice in total during the finals, both for free.
The deck selected cannot be modified after each registration. The challenge ends after winning 5 games or losing 2 games.
You can use any Shikigami from all the series during the event.
· Opening time: 
Qualifiers: Open all day from after the maintenance on January 2, 2025 to 24:00 on January 5, 2025.
Semi-finals: Open all day from January 6, 2025 to 24:00 on January 9, 2025.
Finals: Open all day from January 10, 2025 to 24:00 on January 11, 2025. 
· Guests can gain Gold and Random Card Packs based on the number of wins in each challenge. Guests who advance to the semi-finals/finals will have a chance to get Limited Title - Glorious Ode, Limited Card Back - Flowing Light: Moving Stars, Random Card Packs, Glass Card Frame: Basic, Ink Jade, Glass Stone and more rewards!

Lucky Bag Return Event
· Event Time: From after the maintenance on January 2, 2025 to 24:00 on January 15, 2025.
· During the event, the Autumn Lucky Bag and Golden Autumn Lucky Bag will return for a limited time. Guests can spend 1 Daruma Token or 60 Jade to draw a lucky bag once.
· Unused Daruma Tokens during the event period can be kept for the next event.
· The Lucky Bag Draw rewards are removed from the reward pool once they have been drawn. The system will randomly draw a not yet obtained prize for the guest, according to the draw rate weight of the prizes left.
· The Autumn Lucky Bag contains Juzu Alternative Art - Dragon-slaying Force, Avatar - Juzu: Radiance, Combat Effect - Combat: Sweet Joy, Avatar Frame - Luscious Autumn, and more amazing rewards.
· The Golden Autumn Lucky Bag contains Aoandon: Wildfire's Collector Edition Alternative Art - Lost Time, Card Back - Seeing Deer, Battlefield Special Effect - Broadcast: Thunderclap, and more amazing rewards.
Since this is a Lucky Bag Return Event, rewards you've already drawn will be marked gray and won't be drawn again. If you've collected all the prizes, you won't be able to draw again.
· You can get the rest of the rewards after obtaining the reward of the black Daruma on top.

Improvements and Bug Fixes
· Fixed an issue where playing Brilliance while Youning was in the Classic of Poetry attached form would cause the client to crash.
· Fixed an issue where two Shikigami from the same faction could be included in a deck using Menreiki: Heart.
· Fixed an issue where Evolve: Yamakaze would not trigger its Evolve effect when other Shikigami's countdowns were reduced after the Maestro triggered the Kagura Song effect with Ensemble.
